HMO Conversion

Six-bedroom HMO conversion, Acton W3

Acton, London W3202616 photos

Conversion and full refurbishment of a property in Acton, West London, into a high-specification licensed six-bedroom HMO. Works started in March 2026 and were completed in October 2026. Works included new FD30 fire doors with intumescent seals and self-closers, a fully designed and commissioned fire alarm with emergency lighting and escape signage, a new three-phase electrical supply and consumer unit, new flooring and redecoration throughout. Building control final certificate issued November 2026.
